description: Codex bindings for the shared Claude/Codex agent timing hooks.

hooks.command: CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" bash "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.claude/hooks/agent-timing-smoke.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || printf '{"systemMessage":"smoke checks FAILED — timing instrumentation may be broken; run: bash .claude/hooks/agent-timing-smoke.sh"}'
CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" bash "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.claude/hooks/agent-timing.sh" dispatch 2>/dev/null || true
CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" bash "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.claude/hooks/agent-timing.sh" return 2>/dev/null || true
CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" bash "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.claude/hooks/agent-timing.sh" subagent_start 2>/dev/null || true
CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" bash "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.claude/hooks/agent-timing.sh" subagent_stop 2>/dev/null || true
